goal: Let the user enable or disable each harness hook group in the audit dashboard and apply the selection to Claude Code and Codex.
constraints: Preserve unrelated existing agent hooks and harness hooks on install.
Keep existing behavior when no hook preferences have been saved.
Use the shared config writer to preserve concurrent machine settings.

non_goals.description: Do not change unrelated dispatch, audit projection, or architecture-board behavior.

acceptance.criterion: Dashboard hook selections persist and installation emits only enabled harness hook groups while preserving unrelated hooks.
